title: Nun

paragraphs: In Meilah 19a, Rav Kahana said to Rav Zevid, “Where, then, did the gold of Nun's daughter-in-law go?” Rashi explains that Nun was a wealthy man who gave his daughter-in-law a great deal of money.[^1]

notes.text: The checked Meilah 19a passage has Rav Kahana asking Rav Zevid about Nun’s daughter-in-law’s gold. The checked Rashi gloss describes Nun as wealthy and says he gave her much gold and ornaments; Hyman’s paraphrase says כסף, rendered here as money. These wordings remain distinct, without identifying the similarly named sages beyond the passage.
